title: Industries Overview
meta_description: Twelve industries with sub-industry depth. Each page maps the sector's regulations, systems and workflows to the Achala services that serve them.

blocks.x: Achala works in twelve industries, each with sub-industry pages that map our services to the sector's regulations, systems of record and daily workflows. Start with your industry and see the programs we have run there.
Twelve industries, measured where it bites

Regulated industries get the strictest treatment first: banking and insurance pages lead with decision evidence, healthcare leads with clinical signal governance, public sector leads with auditability. Each industry page shows the programs we run there, the controls they live under, and the deltas the clients' own systems reported.
Open your industry, find the program closest to your problem, and bring the metric to a briefing, the two-week measurement pass behind every baseline below is the same one we would run for you.
Talk to the team that runs the section map above in production. The briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
